more_info.overview: Calcium peroxide is used as a sequestrant in food. Its technological role is to bind metal ions.
more_info.banned_in:
Approved in the US.
US permission is limited to the uses and conditions in 21 CFR 136.110, checked in 2026.
more_info.uses: Permitted in the US as a dough-conditioning ingredient in bread, rolls and buns under the specified limits.
